I went to school for a few years so I can read the names on the fertilizer bags, but I learned farming from my father. Our family has almost four hectares, and I manage this small 0.11 hectare plot near the house while my father looks after the bigger fields. Last season I saw my neighbor's improved maize grow much better than our local seed, so I will plant improved seed this year and apply DAP at planting and urea when the rains come — my father bought bags from the cooperative, and for this plot I will use about 50 kilograms of nitrogen for each hectare. We have cattle, so I will also spread manure here before planting, and my brother and I can do all the work ourselves in about twelve days — I do not have money for chemicals or irrigation, and this plot is too small to hire workers.
